page.notes: Left column top line "qui bibitis uinum" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "necp" (Amos line, likely neque with abbreviation mark); "uçneunt" (Matthew 11, likely veneunt); the Greek "ὁ λόγος" in John 1 is hard to read and the marks around it are unclear; "diufec" (Acts 20) is partly illegible; "92" (Sapientia 18) and the page number "44" are uncertain. The heading "EX EVANGELIO" at the top of the right column appears as "BX" in print. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept in headings and cells.
